title: Premium-Accessory Points on the Replacement System Installations Accessory Member Discount
content:
# Premium-accessory points

## Rule

The premium-accessory points of the accessory member discount on a Replacement System Installations contract follow the total of the accessory charges on the contract, which never includes a labor-warranty upgrade:

- a total of at least $1000.00 adds 2 percentage points;
- a total of at least $500.00 but less than $1000.00 adds 1 percentage point;
- a smaller total adds no premium-accessory points.

## Boundaries (hypothetical totals)

| Total of accessory charges | Points |
|---|---|
| $499.99 | None |
| $500.00 | 1 |
| $999.99 | 1 |
| $1000.00 | 2 |

## Cases (hypothetical contracts)

- A surge protector ($295.00) and a condensate pump ($289.00): $584.00 — 1 point.
- A media air cleaner ($1195.00): $1195.00 — 2 points.
- A smart thermostat upgrade ($389.00) with a labor-warranty upgrade charged on the same contract: the upgrade is not an accessory charge, so the total is $389.00 — no points.
